"Emotional Men" - Standup Comedy by Rakesh Addlakha
Thank you for all the love and support on this incredible journey. Join me in my latest stand-up comedy video for 2024, where I explore a side of men that often goes unspoken—our emotions and vulnerabilities. This family-friendly and clean comedy routine dives into humorous and heartfelt anecdotes that reveal the human side of masculinity.
